skills.name: board-bringup
skills.description: Custom board bringup for Zephyr RTOS using Hardware Model v2 (HWMv2). Covers directory structure, board.yml metadata, core configuration files (Kconfig, defconfig, CMake), and revision management. Trigger when creating new board definitions or porting Zephyr to custom hardware.
skills.summary: Custom board bringup with Hardware Model v2 — board.yml, board directory layout, defconfig.

skills.name: build-system
skills.description: Build system management for Zephyr RTOS. Covers West workspace initialization, manifest management, Sysbuild multi-image builds, Kconfig symbols, and CMake integration. Trigger when setting up workspaces, configuring builds, or troubleshooting build-time errors.
skills.summary: Zephyr build stack — west workspaces and manifests, Kconfig, CMake, Sysbuild multi-image builds.

skills.name: connectivity-ble
skills.description: Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) integration for Zephyr RTOS. Covers GATT Services/Characteristics, GAP advertising, connection parameters, power optimization strategies, and the professional Send-When-Idle design pattern. Trigger when adding BLE connectivity, optimizing battery life for wireless devices, or implementing custom GATT profiles.
skills.summary: Bluetooth Low Energy — GATT services, advertising, connections, BLE power optimization.

skills.name: connectivity-ip
skills.description: IP networking fundamentals for Zephyr RTOS. Covers IoT protocol selection (LwM2M, CoAP, MQTT), IP stack configuration and trimming (IPv4/IPv6, UDP/TCP), and professional SDK integration as Zephyr modules using West manifests. Trigger when building cloud-connected applications, optimizing network memory usage, or integrating external cloud SDKs.
skills.summary: IP networking — MQTT, CoAP, LwM2M, sockets, Wi-Fi, Ethernet, network stack tuning.

skills.name: connectivity-usb-can

Trigger when adding USB interfaces, implementing CAN bus communication, or building hardware diagnostic tools.
skills.summary: USB device stack and CAN bus — CDC-ACM, USB classes, CAN controllers, CANopen.

skills.name: devicetree
skills.description: Devicetree management for Zephyr RTOS. Covers syntax, bindings, overlays, Hardware Model v2 (HWMv2), and advanced node/property deletion patterns. Trigger when defining hardware topology, creating overlays, or mapping pins and peripherals.
skills.summary: Devicetree authoring — overlays, bindings, node status, pinctrl, /delete-node/.

skills.name: hardware-io
skills.description: Hardware interfacing and peripheral management for Zephyr RTOS. Trigger when adding new hardware components, configuring pinmux, or developing sensor-based applications.
skills.summary: Peripheral driver usage — GPIO, I2C, SPI, ADC, PWM, UART, the sensor subsystem, pinmux.

skills.name: industrial
skills.description: Industrial communication protocols for Zephyr RTOS. Covers Modbus RTU (serial), Modbus TCP (Ethernet/Wi-Fi), and CANopen basics. Trigger when building factory automation controllers, industrial sensors, or medical equipment interfaces.
skills.summary: Industrial fieldbus protocols — Modbus RTU, Modbus TCP, CANopen.

skills.name: iot-protocols

skills.summary: Long-range and mesh IoT — OpenThread, Matter, LoRaWAN, Golioth cloud.

skills.name: kernel-basics

skills.summary: Core kernel — threads, scheduling and priority, the logging subsystem, the shell.

skills.summary: Advanced kernel services — Zbus pub/sub, State Machine Framework, work queues, Settings.

skills.summary: Multicore and AMP — SMP, RPMsg/OpenAMP IPC, LLEXT, nRF5340 multi-domain sysbuild.

skills.summary: Host simulation on native_sim — build and run on Linux/macOS, host-side GDB and Valgrind.
